title: New-Purchase Rush Discount for Garments Bought at Marlowe & Finch — Marlowe & Finch Alterations
content:
When a garment on a Marlowe & Finch Alterations rush ticket comes from the customer's own Marlowe & Finch purchase, a new-purchase rush discount applies, read from the purchase record the ticket names in Merchandise Purchases:

| Purchase record named on the ticket | New-purchase rush discount |
|---|---|
| The customer's own purchase record at regular price, completed 30 or fewer calendar days before the ticket's drop-off date | 10 percent |
| Any other Marlowe & Finch purchase record of the customer: a price type other than regular, or completed more than 30 days before the drop-off date, or not yet completed | 5 percent |
| No Marlowe & Finch purchase record named | none |

**Records read.** From the Merchandise Purchases record the ticket names: its price type (regular, or another type such as sale, clearance, doorbuster or final sale) and its completed date. From the ticket: its drop-off date.

## The 30-day threshold, both sides

| Regular-price purchase completed | Days before drop-off | Discount |
|---|---|---|
| 30 calendar days before the drop-off date | 30 | 10 percent |
| 31 calendar days before the drop-off date | 31 | 5 percent |

## Hypothetical cases

- A suit bought at regular price and completed 12 days before drop-off: 10 percent.
- A dress bought on sale and completed 5 days before drop-off: 5 percent, because its price type is not regular.
- An online order not yet completed whose garment is brought in: 5 percent.
- Trousers bought from another retailer, with no purchase record named on the ticket: none.
